summary: Edenor S.A., the Argentine electricity distributor listed on NYSE, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a material fact notice to the CNV and Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos announcing that its Board of Directors resolved to call an Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting for November 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. first call and 11:00 a.m. second call, held remotely via Microsoft Teams from the registered office. The filing names CFO Germán Ranftl and Market Relations Officer Lucila Ramallo. No special-situation terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated; this is a routine meeting notice.
